issues.quote: A banana grows from part of a flower, and it is soft all the way through.
issues.problem: Misleading. A banana has a peel that is not soft or eaten. Only the flesh inside is soft. The source describes a protective peel with strings under it. The sentence could also be unclear about why this makes it a berry.
issues.fix: A banana grows from part of a flower, and the part we eat is soft flesh inside its peel.
